pages.text: Two ordinary $(l:companions/combat)Combat Slimes$() become a cord-linked pair through $(l:world/colony_bonding)Colony Bonding$(). Each moves and fights separately, sharing health, stamina, cargo and orders. Base Attack is 60% of their combined values. Deployment starts in Wait.
pages.title: Combat Slime Colony

pages.text: The management screen has two groups of sword, shield and armor slots. Each member uses and wears its own equipment. When one finds an enemy, its partner can leap in for a 1.5× critical attack. The leap costs 3 stamina, plus 1 on a hit, and has a five-second cooldown. Obstacles or Wait interrupt it.

Damage and healing update both records. Unused points start at their mean rounded down. One point upgrades each uncapped member. Growth is half rate while any role stat can upgrade both; otherwise normal. Unbinding restores both identities and traits and copies the point balance to each. Target settings initially copy member one.
